set.body:
Outcome

Move centroid, ridge-LDA, optimized searchlight scanning, and cross-domain decoding to predictive estimands.

Acceptance

- Each method declares target, adaptation regime, fitting scope, class-score semantics, and validation design.
- Optimized and reference executors obey the common conformance laws.
- Transductive or supervised adaptation is named explicitly and cannot receive safe capabilities accidentally.
- Old classifier and cross-decoding implementations are deleted as consumers move.
set.title: P5.1: migrate classifiers, optimized scanners, and cross-domain decoding
